label: PF Backlog 226
title: Backend: product BOM / footprint artifact at packaging (deps, licenses, sizes, model weights, runtime requirements)
body:
## Problem / why The Product tab must show what the product is made of and what it needs to run; today there is no BOM. ## Goal & value Emit a machine-readable BOM + human summary at the package stage: components, licenses, sizes, model weights, and runtime footprint (CPU/GPU/VRAM/RAM/disk), plus bundle-safety verdict (BI-0211). ## In scope - Collect deps (pyproject/lockfiles), model weights used (catalog + models.lock), licenses, sizes. - Runtime footprint estimate (from capability packs + feasibility BI-0214). - Output `products/

/artifacts/9 - Package/BOM.json` + `BOM.md`; fail on non-bundle_allowed. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - BOM lists every dependency + weight with size + license + bundle_allowed; footprint present. - A restricted component fails packaging unless API-only. ## Verification / test plan - Unit: BOM assembly from fixtures; footprint calc; bundle-gate pass/fail. ## Links docs/product-portal.md; BI-0211; BI-0214; dashboard BI-0149.
_note: core/bom.py single writer of artifacts/9 - Package/BOM.json; wired at stage 9 + CLI bom; store registered; docs/BOM-DESIGN.md; +1 test; precheck PASS.
